title: Product Attributes
description: Learn how to define and use product attributes to organize and filter products effectively.
content:
Product Attributes

Product attributes help organize products and allow customers to filter and search more effectively. Attributes can be used for variants, filtering, and product organization.

Understanding Attributes

Attributes are properties of products such as:

  • Size (S, M, L, XL)
  • Color (Red, Blue, Green)
  • Material (Cotton, Leather, Metal)
  • Brand
  • Style
  • Season
  • Custom properties

Creating Attributes

Step 1: Access Attributes

Navigate to Products → Attributes to manage product attributes.

Step 2: Create Attribute

Click "Create Attribute" and provide:

  • Attribute name (e.g., "Size", "Color")
  • Slug (URL-friendly identifier)
  • Description

Step 3: Add Values

Add possible values for the attribute:

  • For "Size": S, M, L, XL, XXL
  • For "Color": Red, Blue, Green, Black, White
  • For "Material": Cotton, Polyester, Leather

Assigning Attributes to Products

When creating or editing a product:

  1. Go to the Attributes section
  2. Select the attribute from the dropdown
  3. Choose one or more values
  4. Save the product

    5. Attribute Types

    Text Attributes

    Free-form text values (e.g., custom notes, specifications).

    Select Attributes

    Predefined list of values (e.g., size, color). Better for filtering and variants.

    Color Attributes

    Special attribute type that displays as color swatches on the frontend.

    Image Attributes

    Attributes with images (e.g., color swatches with images).

    Using Attributes for Filtering

    Attributes enable powerful filtering:

    • Customers can filter products by attribute values
    • Filter widgets in sidebar
    • Search by attribute values
    • URL-based filtering

    Attributes for Variants

    Attributes are essential for product variants:

    • Define variant combinations
    • Generate variants automatically
    • Price and inventory per variant

    Managing Attributes

    You can:

    • Edit attribute names and values
    • Reorder attribute values
    • Delete unused attributes
    • Merge duplicate attributes
    • Export/import attributes

    Display Options

    Configure how attributes appear:

    • Show in product listings
    • Display in product details
    • Use in filter widgets
    • Color swatches
    • Image swatches
    • Dropdown selectors

    Best Practices

    • Use consistent attribute names
    • Keep attribute values standardized
    • Don't create too many attributes
    • Use attributes that help customers find products
    • Review and clean up unused attributes regularly
